description: This is a React component file defining the 'Invite' component for handling subscription sharing invitations, including UI state management, form validation, and interaction with external services.

classes.name: Invite
classes.description: React functional component for managing the invitation process to share a subscription, including form validation, step flow, and modal controls.

methods.name: validateInviteeEmail
methods.description: Validates the email format of the invitee and provides user feedback if invalid.

methods.name: handleDialogClose
methods.description: Handles closing the dialog, preventing closure if tasks are pending.

methods.name: resetProgressState
methods.description: Resets UI state related to button titles and progress flags.

methods.name: processInvite
methods.description: Sends the invitation using the subscription state service and manages lock state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Coordinates the submission process: validation, sending invite, updating UI state, and managing user flow.
